d:
Starring Ranbir Kapoor as Ram, Yash as Ravan and Sai Pallavi as Sita, Ramayana Part One, directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra, brings one of India's greatest epics to the big screen on an unprecedented scale.
In this episode of Firstpost Presents: First Cut, Dabeet Singh reviews , breaking down the performances, direction, action sequences, VFX and storytelling to find out whether this ambitious adaptation does justice to the epic.
